source_caption_text:
DDG’s mom said he retired her 9 years ago and she’s been living her dream life ever since 🙏❤️

Respect!

DDG retired his mom 9 years ago, but he didn’t exactly give her time to think about it 😭❤️ He bought her an apartment first, then told her people were coming to pick up her stuff. He already had the move planned before she could even agree 😂🙏

What started as him basically telling his mom she was moving turned into nearly a decade of making sure she gets to live her dream life. He wanted her to be able to stop working and enjoy the success with him, and he took it upon himself to make that happen.

Buying her a place was the beginning. Continuing to look after her all these years later is what makes the story special. Being in a position to take that weight off your mom’s shoulders has to be one of the best feelings ❤️💯
